content.text:
**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — no redline proposed.

Section 8.1 delivers a vendor-side IP defence and indemnity (patent, trademark, copyright, trade secret) for Materials and Base Components, extended to Bluefly's Enterprise and personnel, with standard claim procedure and the customary exclusions and remedies (continue use / modify / replace / credit up to 12 months of charges). Section 9.1(a) carves indemnification payments out of IBM's liability cap, so the indemnity is effectively uncapped — better than the fallback's 3× super-cap.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged under this rule: the indemnity omits the preferred non-IP heads (breach of law, IBM-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), it is stated as IBM's "entire obligation" for infringement, and our own indemnity in 8.2 is broader than the preferred Customer-content-only scope (particularly 8.2(a)(3) for Services Recipient claims, partly offset by the misconduct carve-back).
